_why: F3b. capture_c1_privet.png is an IN-GAME frame: the map view differs by ~15% between runs (fog, camera, unit idle animation), and the chat line itself is drawn in the SENDER's faction colour, which the game assigns per match (cyan one run, red the next). Only the chat line's glyph SHAPES are the claim, so this capture is compared ONLY inside the top-left text band, colour-blind (ink mode). The band is kept tight: one line of text at the frame's top-left. mods:LANG3 RU variant: same claim, same band. capture_c_lobby.png also masks the host's adapter address in the right-panel header (standard own-IP rect) -- it comes from the adapters, not the pinned setup.dat. PING CELL (2026-09-29, the chat_utf8 flake's root cause): with a client seated, mp:L1b's lobby ping cell (mh/ui/lobby_ping.cpp, right of each seated row's colour swatch) draws a live SRTT MEASUREMENT -- 'D 0' solo, 'D 1' or more under load -- so its column on the two seated rows is masked ([322,106,44,36], mp_client_el2's rect; the text is laid out by width, so the whole column, not the digit). mp:U50 (2026-10-02): the ping became its own widget right of the flag; the ping-cell rects moved left to x=313 with their right edge unchanged.
